<?php
use App\Fiscal\TenantAiVerificationQuota;
use App\Fiscal\TenantAiContext;
use App\Fiscal\TenantAiCredentialVerifier;
use App\Fiscal\TenantAiActiveLifecycle;
use App\Fiscal\CredentialPromotionPermit;
use App\Exceptions\TenantAiStorageUnavailable;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Session\Store;
use Illuminate\Session\ArraySessionHandler;
use Tests\TestCase;
uses(TestCase::class);
require_once '/Users/Oz/Apps/vap-invoice/tests/TenantAiVerificationQuotaFixtures.php';
function reviewerContext($user, $fixture) {
 config(['tenant_ai.deployment_id'=>$fixture['row']['deployment_id']]);auth('web')->login($user);
 $s=new Store('independent-review',new ArraySessionHandler(120));$s->start();$s->put((string)config('work_session.started_at_key'),time());$s->put('auth.password_confirmed_at',time());
 $r=Request::create('/offline-review','POST');$r->setLaravelSession($s);$r->headers->set('X-CSRF-TOKEN',$s->token());$r->setUserResolver(fn()=>$user);app()->instance('request',$r);
 return TenantAiContext::resolve($r,$fixture['row']['workspace_public_id']);
}
function reviewerPersist($f,$time) {
 DB::table('assistant_provider_attempts')->insert([...$f['row'],'admitted_at'=>$time]);
 foreach($f['allocations'] as $a){DB::table('assistant_provider_allocations')->insert([...$a,'created_at'=>$time]);}
 DB::statement('SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE');
}
test('independent overlapping admission preserves A1 ceiling',function(bool $otherProvider,bool $differentActor){
 expect(DB::connection()->getDatabaseName())->toBe('facturac_test_verification_cr1_checkpoint_runtime_final2');
 $u=User::factory()->create(['two_factor_secret'=>'offline','two_factor_confirmed_at'=>now()]);
 $v=$differentActor?User::factory()->create(['two_factor_secret'=>'offline','two_factor_confirmed_at'=>now()]):$u;
 $fixtures=[];
 for($i=0;$i<6;$i++){$fixtures[]=DB::transaction(fn()=>verificationQuotaFixture($i===5?$v:$u,null,true,$otherProvider&&$i===5?'openai':'anthropic'));}
 for($i=0;$i<4;$i++){DB::transaction(fn()=>reviewerPersist($fixtures[$i],DB::selectOne('SELECT clock_timestamp() as t')->t));}
 $dir='/private/tmp/verification-checkpoint/race-'.bin2hex(random_bytes(4));mkdir($dir,0700);DB::purge();$children=[];
 for($i=0;$i<2;$i++){
  $pid=pcntl_fork();
  if($pid===0){
   DB::purge();$me=DB::selectOne('SELECT pg_backend_pid() as p')->p;file_put_contents("$dir/pid-$i",(string)$me);
   if($i===1){while(!is_file("$dir/locked")){usleep(500);}}
   $context=reviewerContext($i===0?$u:$v,$fixtures[$i+4]);$out=['pid'=>$me];
   try{DB::transaction(function()use($i,$context,$fixtures,$dir,&$out){
    $q=new TenantAiVerificationQuota;$q->acquire($context,hrtime(true)/1e9+10);
    if($i===0){file_put_contents("$dir/locked",'1');$until=microtime(true)+3;while(!is_file("$dir/release")){if(microtime(true)>$until){throw new RuntimeException('review barrier timeout');}usleep(500);}}
    DB::table('ai_gateway_controls')->where('deployment_id',$fixtures[$i+4]['row']['deployment_id'])->where('kind','global')->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
    $when=$q->assertAvailable($context);reviewerPersist($fixtures[$i+4],$when->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.uP'));$out['transaction']=DB::selectOne('SELECT txid_current() as id')->id;
   });$out['outcome']='committed';}catch(TenantAiStorageUnavailable){$out['outcome']='quota_refused';}catch(Throwable $e){$out['outcome']='error';$out['class']=$e::class;}
   file_put_contents("$dir/out-$i",json_encode($out));DB::disconnect();exit(0);
  }$children[]=$pid;
 }
 $until=microtime(true)+3;$overlap=false;
 while(microtime(true)<$until){
  if(is_file("$dir/pid-1")&&is_file("$dir/locked")){
   $p=(int)file_get_contents("$dir/pid-1");
   if($differentActor?is_file("$dir/out-1"):DB::selectOne("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks WHERE pid=? AND locktype='advisory' AND NOT granted) as waiting",[$p])->waiting){$overlap=true;break;}
  }usleep(500);
 }
 file_put_contents("$dir/release",'1');foreach($children as $pid){pcntl_waitpid($pid,$status);expect(pcntl_wexitstatus($status))->toBe(0);}
 DB::purge();$out=array_map(fn($i)=>json_decode(file_get_contents("$dir/out-$i"),true),[0,1]);
 $count=DB::table('assistant_provider_attempts')->where('actor_attribution_id',$u->attribution_id)->where('contract_version','gateway_v1')->where('purpose','connection_probe')->count();
 file_put_contents("$dir/evidence.json",json_encode(['overlap'=>$overlap,'different_actor'=>$differentActor,'other_provider'=>$otherProvider,'initial'=>4,'final_A1'=>$count,'outcomes'=>$out,'roots'=>array_column(array_column(array_slice($fixtures,4),'row'),'deployment_id')],JSON_PRETTY_PRINT));
 expect($overlap)->toBeTrue()->and($out[0]['pid'])->not->toBe($out[1]['pid'])->and($out[0]['outcome'])->toBe('committed')->and($out[1]['outcome'])->toBe($differentActor?'committed':'quota_refused')->and($count)->toBe(5);
})->with(['cross root tenant credential'=>[false,false],'cross provider metadata'=>[true,false],'independent actors'=>[false,true]]);

test('review counterexample is rejected without receipt or promotion', function () {
 $this->verificationRoots=[];$f=verifierFixture($this);
 try {
  $result=offlineVerifier($f,function($buffer,$f){
   $body=json_encode(['type'=>'model','id'=>$f['manifest']['model']]);
   foreach(['HTTP/1.1 200 OK','Content-Type: application/json','Transfer-Encoding: chunked','Content-Length: '.strlen($body),'anthropic-organization-id: '.$f['account']['organization_id'],'anthropic-workspace-id: '.$f['account']['workspace_id'],''] as $line){expect($buffer->header($line."\r\n"))->toBe(strlen($line)+2);}

  expect($result->status)->toBe('verification-rejected')->and($state)->toBe('pending')->and($valid)->toBeFalse()->and($a->verification_outcome)->toBe('malformed_response');
 }finally{foreach($this->verificationRoots as $root){foreach(['keks','receipts'] as $d){foreach(glob($root.'/'.$d.'/*') as $p){unlink($p);}rmdir($root.'/'.$d);}rmdir($root);}}
});

<?php
use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Fiscal\{TenantAiCredentialVerifier,CredentialPromotionPermit,TenantAiActiveLifecycle,TenantAiVerificationContext,AssistantInteractionContext,AssistantExecutionGuard,AssistantProviderInvocation,AssistantInput,AiInferenceRequest,VapAiGateway,AiGatewayFailure};
uses(TestCase::class);
require_once '/private/tmp/verification-checkpoint/TenantAiVerifierFixtures.php';
test('independent canary custody cross-request replay and active gateway isolation',function(){
 $this->verificationRoots=[];$f=verifierFixture($this);$queries=[];
 DB::listen(function($q)use(&$queries){$queries[]=[$q->sql,$q->bindings];});
 try{
  $session=offlineVerifier($f);$result=$session->verify($f['context'],$f['command']);expect($result->status)->toBe('verified-and-active');
  $replacement=clone $f['request'];app()->instance('request',$replacement);
  $fresh=TenantAiVerificationContext::resolve($replacement,$f['row']['workspace_public_id'],$f['row']['legal_entity_public_id'],'production');
  expect(fn()=>(new TenantAiActiveLifecycle)->promote(new TenantAiCredentialVerifier,$fresh,new CredentialPromotionPermit))->toThrow(App\Exceptions\TenantAiStorageUnavailable::class);
  $url=route('assistant.store',['workspacePublicId'=>$f['row']['workspace_public_id'],'entityPublicId'=>$f['row']['legal_entity_public_id'],'environment'=>'production'],false);
  $req=Illuminate\Http\Request::create($url,'POST');$req->setUserResolver(fn()=>$f['user']);$req->setLaravelSession($f['request']->session());$req->setRouteResolver(fn()=>app('router')->getRoutes()->match($req));app()->instance('request',$req);
  $ctx=AssistantInteractionContext::resolve($req);$guard=new AssistantExecutionGuard;$req->attributes->set('assistant_context',$ctx);$req->attributes->set('assistant_guard',$guard);
  $input=AssistantInput::fromJson(json_encode(['request_nonce'=>(string)Illuminate\Support\Str::uuid(),'question'=>'review question canary','references'=>[]]));
  $reply=app(VapAiGateway::class)->infer(new AiInferenceRequest(AssistantProviderInvocation::forInteraction($ctx,$input,$guard)));
  expect($reply->failure)->toBe(AiGatewayFailure::Unavailable)->and(config('assistant.provider.enabled'))->toBeFalse()->and(config('assistant.provider.egress_enabled'))->toBeFalse();
  $v=DB::table('tenant_ai_credentials')->where('id',$f['command']->credentialId)->first();expect($v->state)->toBe('active')->and($v->last_used_at)->toBeNull();
  $captured=json_encode([$queries,$result,DB::table('activity_log')->where('event','like','assistant.%')->pluck('properties')->all(),json_encode($session)]);
  expect($captured)->not->toContain($f['secret']);$scanned=0;
